title: Merchandise

location.series: IBM Logo and Brand Guidelines for Third Parties / copyright 2022

slide_intent: Adapt trademark rules to physical objects and production limits, because disposability, electrical components and embroidery create different considerations from a printed page.
strategic_value: Specific merchandise boundaries can protect IBM’s presentation while avoiding illegible small registration marks.
demonstration: A heading and introduction lead into two columns of merchandise rules and an approval-contact address.
practical_value: Check the item type, authorization and production method before designing branded merchandise.

content_islands.name: Merchandise scope
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and short usage introduction in the left column.

content_islands.name: Authorization and item life
content_islands.spec: Use the middle column for written permission, reusable-only items and the ban on merchandise sold for profit at or for events.

content_islands.name: Device and reproduction conditions
content_islands.spec: Use the next column for wireless/lithium approval conditions, clothing and small-item registration exceptions, and the contact address.

ingredient.name: Merchandise mark treatment
ingredient.role: Keep the identity appropriate to item life and reproduction quality.
ingredient.application: Use authorized reusable items; omit the registration mark on clothing and on small items where it cannot reproduce clearly.
ingredient.scope: Copyright 2022 third-party merchandise rules. Wireless/Bluetooth/lithium products require prior approval; the next page separately prohibits wall-socket items.

reference_purposes.Intent: The page explains that embroidery and small reproduction can make the registration mark difficult to reproduce clearly.
reference_purposes.Application: The text lists reusable-item examples and identifies the merchandise contact for questions or approvals.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Written permission is required; disposable items and event merchandise sold for profit are excluded. Wireless/Bluetooth/lithium items require prior approval; registration marks are omitted on clothing and small items where unclear.
